blocks.text: SAN JUAN, Puerto Rico (AP) — Thousands of people protested Friday in Puerto Rico ’s capital as anger and frustration erupted over record high electric rates, the surging cost of living, deterioration in basic services and other issues. Retirees, university students, bus drivers and others joined the protest organized by some 30 groups ranging from unions to religious organizations. The crowds gathered in front of the largest mall in the Caribbean on Black Friday for what organizers dubbed the “Day of National Outrage.” Hundreds of demonstrators arrived by bus in San Juan from dozens of cities and towns across the island.
